import os,datetime,json,hashlib,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
from html.parser import HTMLParser
R=Path('/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar');P=R/'docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-19/ari-sneaker-artist'
print('SOURCE_OBSERVER',os.getpid(),datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
prep=json.loads((P/'SOURCE-PREPARATION.json').read_bytes())
checks=[]
for row in prep['sources']+prep['pins']+json.loads((P/'PLAN.json').read_bytes())['inputs']:
 p=R/row['path'];b=p.read_bytes();assert len(b)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
 checks.append(str(p))
svg=(P/'shoe.svg').read_bytes();design=json.loads((P/'design.json').read_bytes())
assert design['source_file']=='shoe.svg' and design['source_bytes']==len(svg) and design['source_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(svg).hexdigest()
assert design['source_xml'].encode()==svg
assert b'<!DOCTYPE' not in svg and b'<!ENTITY' not in svg
root=ET.fromstring(svg);ids={};views=defaultdict(list);features=defaultdict(list);ancestors={}
def visit(e,parent=None,index=0,view=None,feature=None,chain=()):
 ident=e.get('id');assert ident and ident not in ids
 ids[ident]=e;ancestors[ident]=chain
 view=e.get('data-view',view);feature=e.get('data-feature',feature)
 assert view and feature
 views[view].append(ident);features[feature].append(ident)
 return {'id':ident,'tag':e.tag,'attributes':list(map(list,e.attrib.items())),'text':e.text,'tail':e.tail,
         'parent_id':parent,'sibling_index':index,'view':view,'feature':feature,
         'children':[visit(c,ident,j,view,feature,chain+(ident,)) for j,c in enumerate(e)]}
tree=visit(root)
assert tree==design['tree'] and dict(views)==design['view_map'] and dict(features)==design['feature_map']
assert len(ids)==design['element_count']==177 and len(views)==8 and len(features)==37
assert len(svg)<=32768 and (P/'design.json').stat().st_size<=196608 and (P/'review.html').stat().st_size<=8192 and len(ids)<=280
assert all(e.tag.split('}')[-1] in {'svg','title','desc','style','rect','text','line','g','path','circle','ellipse','tspan'} for e in ids.values())
assert not any(k.lower().startswith('on') or k.endswith('href') for e in ids.values() for k in e.attrib)
owned=design['five_pair_ownership']
outer=owned['outer'];inner=owned['inner']
assert outer==['top-eye-outer-'+str(i) for i in range(1,6)] and inner==['top-eye-inner-'+str(i) for i in range(1,6)]
assert all(ids[x].tag.endswith('circle') for x in outer+inner)
for a,b in zip(outer,inner):assert ids[a].get('cy')==ids[b].get('cy')
assert [ids[x].get('cy') for x in outer]==['155','179','203','227','251']
assert all(len([x for x in ids if x.startswith(side+'-eye-')])==5 for side in ['lateral','medial'])
assert len([x for x in ids if x.startswith('detail-eye-')])==6
for k in ['tongue','under_layer','over_layer','finish','inset']:assert owned[k] in ids
children=list(ids['top-shoe']);order=[x.get('id') for x in children]
assert order.index('top-tongue')<order.index('top-eyelet-stays')<order.index('top-five-eyelet-pairs')<order.index('top-lace-under')<order.index('top-lace-over')
detail=[x.get('id') for x in ids['detail-three-central-pairs']]
assert detail.index('detail-under-border')<detail.index('detail-under-tape')<detail.index('detail-over-border')<detail.index('detail-over-tape')
assert len(design['view_conventions'])==7 and set(design['view_conventions'])==set(views)-{'sheet'}
class Viewer(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.links=[];self.tags=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  self.tags.append(tag);assert tag!='script' and all(not k.lower().startswith('on') for k,v in attrs)
  for k,v in attrs:
   if k in ['src','href']:
    assert v and '://' not in v and not v.startswith(('data:','javascript:'))
    assert (P/v.split('#',1)[0]).exists()
    self.links.append(v)
viewer=Viewer();viewer.feed((P/'review.html').read_text())
assert viewer.links==prep['viewer_references'] and len(viewer.links)==7<=12
out={'pid':os.getpid(),'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
'scope':'source XML/JSON/HTML parsing only; no rendering or target/helper import',
'verified_binding_rows':len(checks),'unique_binding_paths':len(set(checks)),
'complete_source_xml_equal':True,'all_tree_fields_and_child_order_equal':True,
'node_count':len(ids),'view_owners':list(views),'feature_count':len(features),
'view_map_partition_complete':True,'feature_map_partition_complete':True,'all_role_refs_resolve':True,
'top_eyelet_pairs':5,'each_profile_visible_eyelets':5,'detail_pairs':3,'lace_paint_order_bound':True,
'viewer_local_references':viewer.links,'caps_pass':True,
'attribute_text_tag_counts':dict(Counter(e.tag.split('}')[-1] for e in ids.values())),
'limits':'Not computed style, layout, paint output, physical pattern, registered projection, fit or appearance qualification.'}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
